thread:
paul: Quick follow-up from the postmortem — we need clear owners, acceptance criteria, and ETAs for the vendor/dependency mitigations. I will maintain the action tracker: https://tracker.company/incidents/1923456789

rachel: I can own the control-plane multi-region failover. Work: terraform ASG changes + route53 healthcheck fallback. ETA: PR 2026-04-20; dry-run 2026-04-27. Acceptance: automated traffic shift with <1% client error delta and no data loss.

emily: I will own the model-registry fallback mapping and sustained-401 alerting. Artifact: priority_map.yaml + CI synthetic that simulates token expiry. ETA: 2026-04-15. Acceptance: CI shows zero unrefreshed tokens in a 24h run and alert fires for >20 401s/min sustained 3m.

chris: Ill take auth-provider hardening: tighten refresh logic, add synthetic regen job, and document fallback tokens. ETA: 2026-04-16. Acceptance: regen job recovers expired tokens in <2m for all simulated cases.

paul: Please add a one-line row to the tracker with owner, artifact, acceptance, ETA. Ill chase any missing owners by EOD tomorrow.

ops-bot: Action created: "vendor-outage-1923-registry-fallback" assigned to emily, due 2026-04-15.

alert-bot: Reminder: weekly incident drill on 2026-04-18 — sign up: https://calendar.company/internal/drills

emily: Example priority_map snippet I will PR: 
```
primary: rwinf-v5
fallbacks:
  - rwinf-v4-quant
  - small-open
```
Will also add KV TTL checks to the runbook to avoid cache-stampede.

rachel: Cross-owner check: emily + rachel will validate the fallback map works with regional failover behavior.

chris: Ops dependency: partner-account team must be notified before the dry-run. Adding that to my tracker row.

paul: Noted. Ill collate these and brief execs next week. If anyone expects to slip, post reason + new ETA here rather than silent misses.

chris: Quick local test I ran: `curl -X POST https://model-registry.internal/test -d '{"simulate":"expired"}' -H 'Authorization: Bearer expired'` -> returns 401. Will add to CI as `ci/registry/expired-token-test`.

emily: CI job name added to tracker: ci/registry/expired-token-test. PR will reference it.

paul: Final ask: update your tracker rows by EOD Friday or Ill reassign. Thanks all. :eyes:

rachel: Will do.

emily: On it.

chris: Done, tracker updated. :white_check_mark:
